explain_en: Company A's balance with B minus company B's balance with A (both as positive numbers). 0 = they agree. A difference is usually an invoice booked by only one side, a different exchange rate, or a payment in transit.
explain_hi: Company A ka B ke saath balance - Company B ka A ke saath balance (dono positive number mein). 0 = dono sahi. Fark aksar ek taraf hi book hua invoice, alag exchange rate ya raste mein payment hota hai.

title_hi: Kya difference ulte digits (transposition) ki galti hai?

explain_en: When two digits are swapped (45 typed as 54) the difference is always divisible by 9. If it is, look for an amount where swapping two digits gives the difference.
explain_hi: Do digits ulte likhne par (45 ki jagah 54) difference hamesha 9 se divide hota hai. Agar ho raha hai to woh amount dhoondo jismein do digits ulatne se yahi fark aata hai.
